# Third-party weapon models

Drop CC0 weapon models here (Milestone 3). Candidates:

- Quaternius "Ultimate Gun Pack" (CC0)
- stein-indie "Free Classic Weapons Pack" (CC0, includes an AK-47)
- 3dmodelscc0 "Guns & Explosives" (CC0)

Log every file you add in `docs/asset_licence_ledger.md` (source URL + licence).
Until a model is here, weapons use primitive placeholders with the same sockets
(grip, support hand, muzzle, magazine).
